title: The April Evening Thomas Burberry's Basingstoke Shop Burned
conflicts: Cause of the 1905 fire: the Basingstoke Gazette says an assistant knocked over a gas lamp, the Hampshire Archives Trust says a milliner was lighting the window with a taper; the story gives both. Gabardine: invented 1879 and patented 1888 per Burberry plc and Sotheby's, 'patented in 1879' per the Hampshire Cultural Trust; the story attributes 1879/1888 to the company.
notes: Episode changed from the slate's 'inventing gabardine, 1879' (no documented moment; the Hampshire Archives Trust calls the shepherd story perhaps apocryphal and says early records were probably destroyed in the 1905 fire) to the well-documented Winchester Street fire of 17 April 1905 and the rebuilt shop of August 1906; arc changed from breakthrough to setback, year 1905. VCH Explore is cited from the IHR's archived GitHub Pages copy.
